# Cressy Lindsay & Orlando

- [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) — Friend of — [Orlando](../character/orlando.md) — corresponds with her and is considered one of her suitors/companions · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) converse in the house before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes out to the garden. There, Hugh joins her and proposes, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rejects his romantic advances in favor of keeping their friendship, which upsets Hugh. Later in her room, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeps over the altered relationship while [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) points out her foolishness.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XX Hugh Speaks

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P0](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0000), [v3 ch.Speaks P16](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0016), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys her stay at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly) with [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Hector](../character/hector.md), and [Orlando](../character/orlando.md) before visiting her childhood home in [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough). The current resident shows her the east room where she was born and gifts her a bundle of old letters written by her late parents. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits her parents' grave, reads the affectionate letters in her room, and feels deeply connected to them at last.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday
